title: Flagship reproduction: Nardostachys jatamansi rhizome-harvest experiment
question: Do COMPADRE matrices for Ghimire et al. (2008) reproduce the paper's monotonic decline of lambda with harvest intensity, and through which vital rates?
hypothesis: lambda decreases monotonically with intensity (0-75%); harvest effect acts mainly through survival/growth (stasis+progression) rather than fecundity, consistent with elasticity of a long-lived clonal herb.
data: COMPADRE 244454-244459; Ghimire et al. 2008 (full text, docs/research)
method: eigen-analysis, power check, fixed LTRE by process, Spearman
finding: Ordering identical to the paper and strictly monotonic (Spearman rho=-1.00); each +10% harvest lowers lambda by 0.036. Exact values differ (COMPADRE = 1999-2002 means). LTRE share of |effect|: progression 38%, retrogression 31%, stasis 29%, fecundity 2%: harvest acts through growth/survival and shrinkage of ramet clusters, not seed production.

result.paper_note: Paper reports year-specific lambdas (1999-2000 shown); COMPADRE stores 1999-2002 mean matrices, so values are expected to be higher (paper states lambda rose after year 1) and not identical.
